regime_context: This China A-shares detector shows a narrowing rotation led by Gold Miners (durability 0.91, trend-stable, full breadth) with Industrial Metals as the only notable challenger; the absolute-trend gate did NOT help drawdowns on this market's history (gate_helps=false), and the backtest verdict is explicit that momentum rank is a focus lens with near-zero rank-IC. Given the 0.375 directional accuracy in the track record and the mean-reverting whipsaw tape, I am producing only a small number of low-conviction, falsifiable conditionals rather than broad calls.
emerging_watch: Watching Banks (rank 8, eligible=false, crowded=true, breadth 0.944): if it regains eligible=true status with its current high breadth and crowds further, that is a confirmed value/financials handoff away from the resource-led tape; if it stays ineligible while Gold and Metals hold the top two slots, the resource narrative is intact and the watch retires.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the only scorable theme with both a genuine positive rank score (1.302, rank 2) and broad participation (breadth 0.846) that is not currently crowded (crowding_z -0.13), making it the checkable proxy for the resource-cyclical leadership showing up alongside Gold. The trend gate leg is the only validated risk control, and while it does not help on this market's history, its 'eligible=true' status plus the theme's mid-tier durability (0.72, mixed hurst) frames it as a rotational runner rather than a pure momentum bet.
evidence: rank score 1.302, second only to unscorable Gold Miners
breadth 0.846 vs Gold's 1.0 and AI Compute's 0.294
theses.dissent: The gate_helps=false verdict means the absolute-trend discipline does not cut drawdown on this mean-reverting tape, so any overweight on a cyclicals theme is exposed to the same whipsaw that defeated the gate historically; Industrial Metals could just as easily be the second leg of a resource narrative that is already peaking.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics has a superficially attractive rank-3 score (1.285) but the internals are degenerate: breadth is only 0.294, hurst_tag is 'mean-revert', and the crowding_z of -0.56 shows money has been leaving rather than accumulating. This is attention without follow-through, exactly the pattern the guardrails warn not to chase as a return forecast.
evidence: rank score 1.285 but breadth 0.294 (leadership is narrow)
hurst_tag 'mean-revert' contradicts a durable trend thesis
scorable via 515000.SS so the underweight can be graded
theses.dissent: AI is the dominant macro narrative (ai_tech tied for most headlines), and a single policy or sentiment catalyst could reignite breadth and turn this into a genuine trend overnight; underweighting the macro story risks missing a regime flip.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 6% over the 20-day window while its breadth rises above 0.6

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is the only scorable theme that is actually crowded (crowding_z 1.15, crowded=true) while sitting mid-pack (rank 5, score 0.508) with only 0.357 breadth and a mixed hurst tag. The crowding flag is explicitly a size-down caution, not a fade, and an avoid lean is the sober read for a theme whose flow has run ahead of its trend health.
evidence: crowded=true with crowding_z 1.15 (the highest crowded flag among scored themes above rank 12)
theses.dissent: Crowding alone has no basket-level forward edge and specifically is forbidden as a fade trigger; the theme could hold its ground or keep grinding higher on CXO contract news that the coincident crowding flag simply cannot see.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 by more than 5% with breadth expanding above 0.6 within the 20-day window
